title: terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_weak_ptr' in ROS 2: shared_from_this() in node constructors, image_transport, tf2_ros and components, measured
excerpt: Why shared_from_this() in an rclcpp node constructor aborts with bad_weak_ptr, and which fixes worked on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: passing this, init() after make_shared, a one-shot timer, on_configure. Plus the reference cycle init() can create and two workarounds that crash or dangle.
